cards.title: AI test moves to the factory
cards.question: Why can complex AI packages increase production test spending?
cards.selfCheck: More interfaces and thermal stress raise test burden; measure tester-hours per good device.
cards.prompt: Hypothesis: test intensity rises with HBM and complex packages, but parallelism can offset it. Contrast yesterday's lab validation thesis with production test. https://investors.teradyne.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-434981/ter-ex99_1.htm

cards.title: TER gets paid for test time
cards.question: Can Teradyne capture more value per AI device?
cards.selfCheck: Q3 semiconductor test $1.072B; check repeat orders and test intensity.
cards.prompt: Fact: Oct 27 revenue $1.306B, up 70% YoY; record memory and integrated systems test revenue. AI-specific incremental profit not disclosed. https://investors.teradyne.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-434981/ter-ex99_1.htm

cards.title: September's memory tester needs orders
cards.question: When does Magnum E2 become a revenue contributor?
cards.selfCheck: Sep 29 launch; verify qualifications, paid shipments and repeat orders.
cards.prompt: Original Sep 29 Magnum E2 announcement; Oct 27 record memory test is category-level confirmation, not E2-specific sales. Oct 6 Titan HP launch adds burn-in capability. Nov 16 conference announcement is not new operating proof. Next 2–6 months: product adoption. https://investors.teradyne.com/news-events/press-releases https://investors.teradyne.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-434981/ter-ex99_1.htm

cards.title: 70% growth can hide a plateau
cards.question: What if annual growth masks slowing sequential demand?
cards.selfCheck: Q3 $1.306B vs Q2 $1.329B; test sequential orders and margins.
cards.prompt: Hypothesis: market may extrapolate annual growth despite sequential decline. Current consensus and valuation unverified; no mispricing claim. Nov 23 sector rebound is not earnings proof. https://investors.teradyne.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-434981/ter-ex99_1.htm

cards.title: TER: wait for the second order
cards.question: What evidence would upgrade the production-test thesis?
cards.selfCheck: Require repeat memory orders and stable margins; reject sustained demand reversal.
cards.prompt: Educational WAIT framework. Next quarterly report: compare semiconductor test with $1.072B baseline, check product qualification and cash conversion. Compare current forward multiple with normalized earnings before entry; no verified multiple today. https://investors.teradyne.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-434981/ter-ex99_1.htm

cards.title: Count tester-hours, not chips
cards.question: How can test revenue grow faster than chip units?
cards.selfCheck: Tester demand scales with units × test time ÷ parallelism; check utilization.
cards.prompt: Include retest, yield, uptime and equipment reuse. More complexity need not mean more equipment if parallelism or utilization improves. Compare KEYS design-stage demand with TER production-stage demand. https://investors.teradyne.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-434981/ter-ex99_1.htm
